create_instructions_component: create an Instructions component for an agent named Alice with default role playing instructions
create_instructions_custom_label: create an Instructions component with a custom pre_act_label for agent Bob
get_instructions_state: get the state dictionary containing the role playing instructions and pre_act_label
set_instructions_state: set the state of an Instructions component to update its role playing text
get_dynamic_instructions_state: get the dynamic state variables of an Instructions component that can be edited at runtime
